_comment: One TTFV receipt per reader per track. Fill by hand following docs/measurement/ttfv-protocol.md; delete no keys. Null means not reached, not applicable, or unknown. Save as docs/measurement/receipts/YYYY-MM-DD-<handle>-<track>.json. track: demo | own-agent. date: YYYY-MM-DD of the attempt. facilitator: a handle only, no personal data. network: yes | no, whether the machine had internet access during the attempt; required yes for Track A and for uv tool install; checked once before the clock starts (protocol 2.7). coaching_events: list of {"at", "what"}. failures: list of {"at", "milestone", "what"}, kept even when the attempt failed.

reader._comment: handle: a public handle, no other personal data. kind: cold | maintainer | ai-agent; only cold receipts without coaching events count toward cold-reader metrics.

machine._comment: os and cpu as reported by the system (e.g. uname -sr, CPU model and core count); python and uv are `python3 --version` and `uv --version`. uv_cache: cold (fresh UV_CACHE_DIR) or warm.

package._comment: version: the agent-reliability-ci version installed. source: pypi or wheel. wheel_sha256: required when source is wheel (record UV_FIND_LINKS and any UV_CACHE_DIR in notes, protocol 2.3). readme_url: the README read, at a fixed commit.

project._comment: Track B only; null for demo. kind: own | sample. description: what the agent is, or which recipe the sample tree came from. refs_preexisting: baseline, candidate, toolset and oracle were importable before the clock started. workers: worker count of the run.

timestamps._comment: ISO 8601 with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-20T09:15:02Z. Track A uses readme_opened, command_start, demo_banner, demo_verdict, all_steps_held, interpretation_answered. Track B uses readme_opened, install_start, install_done, scaffold_start, descriptor_written, run_start, verdict_printed, store_validated, interpretation_answered. Leave the others null.

durations_seconds._comment: Whole seconds derived from the timestamps as the protocol defines per track (sections 3 and 4). agent_execution is Track B only: the sum of usage.wall_seconds over trials.jsonl in the run store (protocol 4.2), never subtracted from total.

outcome._comment: completed: every stop condition of the track held. verdict: PASS | BLOCK | INCONCLUSIVE | ERROR; Track B: the verdict stamped as verdict_printed; ERROR if none; Track A: the verdict for agent B. store_validated, decision_sha256, init_attempts, descriptor_hand_edited, trials_started: Track B only (protocol 4.3 and 4.6). descriptor_hand_edited: arci.yaml edited by hand before the run that produced the verdict, or, with no valid verdict, before any arci run that started trials. trials_started: trials.jsonl in the run store (protocol 4.2) exists and is non-empty. interpretation_correct is scored with the key in protocol 5.3.
outcome.interpretation_answer: BLOCK for agent B against agent A: under this experiment's conditions (200 trials per arm, the declared tool_timeout fault on reserve), B's success rate is lower than A's by more than the allowed drop (bounds on the difference entirely below -0.10), so the candidate is worse than the baseline on this predeclared experiment; the verdict does not say why.

comprehension._comment: Answered once per reader, on the first track's receipt; on a second-track receipt set answered_on to that file name and leave the rest empty. Answers verbatim; scores per the key in protocol section 5; scorer is not the reader and is a handle only, no personal data. q2_who_for keeps its name for schema stability; it holds the whole q2 answer (who it is for and what the agent must expose).

notes: Maintainer-machine run by the AI orchestrator that wrote the documentation; never a cold reader. The command was `uvx --from <wheel> arci demo` with UV_CACHE_DIR set to a fresh empty directory (uv_cache: cold); the README's form `uvx --from agent-reliability-ci arci demo` could not be used because the package was not yet on PyPI at measurement time (wheel built locally from main 48e60ac, sha256 above). `readme_opened` is the script start, so `total` excludes reading. Two further samples with a warm cache, same wheel, same machine: 2026-10-13T07:41:26Z install 1 s, run 71 s, total 72 s (exit 0); 2026-10-13T07:43:59Z install 1 s, run 72 s, total 73 s (exit 0). Deviation from protocol 3: the demo verdict for agent B printed at demo_verdict is BLOCK (exit 1 inside the demo); exit_code here is the demo command's own exit (0 = all six steps held). The interpretation answer is the orchestrator's and is left unscored because no scorer other than the reader was available at the time. Comprehension was not asked of this reader; see the own-agent receipt's notes for the separate context-free cold read (5/5).
